functions.name: CHECK
functions.description: Lender Watch: what lenders report about these companies. Returns flag, the name lenders use, value as % of the amount owed, change in a quarter, and the filing link.

parameters.name: names
parameters.description: The cells holding company names, for example A2:A6.

parameters.name: as_of
parameters.description: Optional quarter-end date, such as 2026-03-31. Leave out for the latest quarter.

functions.name: MEASURE
functions.description: Lender Watch prototype: an agreed measure for these companies, on this computer only. Returns value, unit and source (filing or synthetic).

parameters.name: measure
parameters.description: The measure's id, such as cost_in_flagged.

parameters.name: names
parameters.description: The cells holding company names, for example A2:A10.
